title: lagsw Profiles Configuration Schema
description: Validation schema for lagsw packet interceptor YAML profiles configuration.

global_filter.description: Fallback capture filter expression applied to profiles that do not define a specific filter.

servers.description: Configured target servers: pre-known addresses and named server groups. Automatic discovery is configured by features.server_discovery.

addresses.description: List of pre-known server addresses, optionally formatted as 'address:name' or IP/hostname strings.

additionalProperties.description: Named server group. Selecting any server in the group filters traffic for every server in the group.

server_discovery.description: Discovers the authoritative server from the traffic observed on a port: the remote address receiving the most packets in each window is selected.

port.description: Port to observe TCP and UDP traffic on.

interval.description: Length of the discovery window in milliseconds.

disconnect_drop_percent.description: A discovery window whose packet count falls this many percent below the recent average is reported as a disconnect. 0 disables disconnect detection.

probe_port.description: Port used for region probe latency checks.

pcap_files.description: Debug PCAP capture settings. A PCAP file is written for each enabled profile activation.

enabled.description: Whether debug PCAP file production is enabled.

output_dir.description: Directory for PCAP files, relative to the current working directory unless absolute.

enabled_for.description: A wildcard or profile-name list identifying activations that produce PCAP files. Required when enabled.

desync_countdown.description: Approximate post-deactivation positional-desync countdown for selected profiles.

enabled.description: Whether the status-line countdown is enabled.

display.description: alongside: show the countdown next to profile activations; override: show the countdown instead of the profile's activation status; until_reactivated: hide the countdown when the profile is reactivated.

duration_percent.description: Estimated desync duration as a percentage of the selected profile's most recent active duration.

enabled_for.description: A wildcard or profile-name list for which to show estimates. Required when enabled.

forwarded_address_discovery.description: Dynamically discovers client source/destination addresses when this PC forwards traffic for another device (e.g. via Internet Connection Sharing).

enabled.description: Whether forwarded address discovery is enabled.

inbound.description: Interface index of the interface the client device is directly connected to. Used to discover client_destination_address.

outbound.description: Interface index of the shared/internet-facing interface (e.g. Wi-Fi, Ethernet, or VPN with Internet Connection Sharing enabled). Used to discover client_source_address.

port.description: Port to observe traffic on, the same way server_discovery.port scopes server discovery. Excludes unrelated interface traffic such as broadcasts.

interval.description: Length of the discovery window in milliseconds. The most frequently observed address per interface within each window is selected, weeding out one-off addresses such as broadcasts.

netfilter_monitor.description: Extra status line with NFQUEUE/nftables health (kernel queue depth and drops, table presence). Only reported by the Linux nfqueue backend.

enabled.description: Whether the extra status line is shown.

interval.description: Minimum time between samples, in milliseconds.

backlog_threshold.description: Number of packets waiting in the kernel queue at which the line is flagged as backlogged.

profiles.description: List of packet interception profile definitions.

name.description: Display name of the profile shown in log outputs and status reports.

key.description: Single key name (e.g. 'x', 'space', 'tab', 'ctrl', 'alt', 'shift') or key code.

keys.description: List or comma-separated representation of activation keys.

send_key.description: Optional key that releases the configured amount of deferred packets without deactivating the profile. Cannot overlap any profile activation key.

key_mode.description: 'combination' requires holding all keys simultaneously; 'oneof' triggers on any key in the list.

mode.description: Activation mode ('toggle' switches state on key press; 'hold' remains active while held; 'period' automatically deactivates after activation_period).

activation_period.description: Activation duration in milliseconds for period mode.

disables.description: Name of a profile, '*', or array of profile names to keep disabled while this profile is active.

disable_wait_ms.description: Time in milliseconds to remain active after this profile is disabled.

disable_wait_percent.description: Additional disable wait as a percentage of this profile's current enabled time.

respect_disable_wait.description: Whether this profile waits for profiles it disables to finish their disable_wait_ms before activating.

delay_mode.description: Strategy for packet delaying, dropping, or reinjection.

subsequent_packet_hold_mode.description: For hold_and_send, also hold subsequent TCP packets matching held packets by sequence, acknowledgment, or both.

ack_restoration.description: Allow ACK-only TCP packets through immediately and raise released PSH packet ACK numbers to the highest ACK already sent.

ratio.description: Packet ratio expressed as a count (e.g., 3) or percentage (e.g., '50%'). Required for 'ratio', 'drop_and_send', and 'hold_and_send' delay modes. 'hold_and_send' requires a count.

amount.description: For hold_until_deactivation, the number of deferred packets released on deactivation; 0 releases all deferred packets.

group_count.description: Positive number of packet groups to capture when delay_mode is packet_group_send.

group_order.description: Order in which packet_group_send releases captured groups.

ratio_selection.description: Which packets within the batch are released immediately when using a percentage-based ratio: the first x, the last x, or a random x. Only applies to percentage-based ratio values.

filter.description: Profile-specific capture filter expression. Overrides top-level global_filter.

sniff.description: Sniff packets without diverting them from the stack.

forward.description: Capture routed (forwarded) traffic instead of traffic to and from this host.

outbound.description: Restrict filter capture to outbound packets.

client_address_enforcement.description: Controls whether the configured client source address, destination address, neither, or both are included in the filter.

server_direction.description: Direction filter added when an active server is selected.
